dedupe_keys.name: crc mongolia mobile coverage map 2g to 5g coverage by operator with kml downloads

description: The Communications Regulatory Commission of Mongolia runs a public coverage map for the country's mobile networks. For each operator (Unitel, Mobicom, Skytel, G-Mobile and ONDO) and each generation (2G, 3G, 4G and 5G), the map overlays a coverage image on Google Maps with its bounding box, and the same layer is available as a KML file through the map's public files interface. For example, Unitel's 4G layer, with a bounding box covering the whole country from about 88.5 to 116.5 degrees east, has a KML file of about 0.8 MB last modified in October 2024. Not every operator and generation combination has a file: Unitel 5G returned no layer. The commission also runs a statistics portal and publishes a dataset on the national open data portal, neither of which could be read. Coverage: Mongolia, by operator and technology. Format and access: web map with PNG overlays and KML downloads, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: coverage is operator-declared or modelled; the interface is undocumented and only answers requests that carry the map's own origin; layers may be from 2024 and were not checked for later updates. Simulation uses: coverage extent by operator and technology across a sparsely populated country, for Mongolian service, emergency communication and hazard exposure models such as winter disasters (dzud). Related records: the ITU ICT statistics give national series; the OpenCelliD database gives crowdsourced cell locations for Mongolia.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)

notes: Endpoints found in the map's script and sampled on 2026-09-26 with the site's Origin and Referer headers (Unitel 4G returned metadata; Unitel 5G returned 403). The KML size and date are from a HEAD request. stat1.crc.gov.mn reset the connection; opendata.gov.mn is script-rendered.
